messages.author: d709c45a1978a482
messages.subject: MANOVA in Rstan
parts:
Hello Stan-users

I am a new user of Rstan. I was wondering if there are any examples of MANOVA (mostly) in Stan. 

I have one categorical variable IV with three categories and four continuous DVS. I would be more 
than grateful if you could show me using an example how to apply this in RStan

Thank you very much

Chris

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: MANOVA in Rstan
parts:
On Thursday, August 13, 2015 at 2:25:12 PM UTC-4, Christos Giannoulis wrote:
I am a new user of Rstan. I was wondering if there are any examples of MANOVA (mostly) in Stan.

It is pretty much the SUR example

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stan-dev/example-models/master/misc/sur/sur.stan

with only dummy variables as predictors. Also, note that the .stan program should be

L_Sigma <- diag_pre_multiply(L_sigma, L_Omega);

rather than diag_post_multiply(L_Omega, L_sigma).

Ben
